resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Verified against aviationstack.com/pricing (2026). Free plan remains 100 requests/month and HTTP-only. Official pricing also states free is limited to real-time flights (historical requires paid). Updated free_tier_limits to include that feature restriction while keeping the confirmed quota and HTTP-only notes. Other entry fields were not disputed and remain null (keep original).
free_tier_limits: 100 API requests/month (Free plan); HTTP only (HTTPS requires paid); free tier limited to real-time flights (no historical)
